caption: The drawing features a central triangular structure in blue, containing a bust of a figure with pale skin and white hair, dressed in a pale yellow coat, within the triangle’s opening; above the head, a small circular face is depicted. The triangle is labeled "G. WASHINGTON" in black letters on a yellow banner. The base of the triangle, also blue, is decorated with a spinning wheel and a small flag or pennant in light red and white. The background consists of four fluted columns, each adorned with pink flowers on climbing vines and blue-green leaves. These columns stand on a black-and-white checkered floor with horizontal mustard-colored lines. Above, the columns support a blue and pink draped canopy, from which two large, arching floral vines with pink blooms and green leaves extend toward the center, crossing above the triangle. The walls and background are filled with a mustard yellow color. At the lower left corner, small text reads “No 2. E. VALENTINE.”
title: Wall Paper and Border
